xBRIEFInfo.description: Approved change proposal for the Module 11 curriculum scope
xBRIEFInfo.author: agent:codex

narratives.Problem: Learners can implement and verify a bounded change through Module 10, but they cannot yet conduct a complete pre-PR self-review, classify every review finding before editing, prepare one coherent fix batch, or make evidence-bounded completion claims.
narratives.Change: Author Module 11 as a command-free fixed-state review and completion exercise, add its explained solution, update source and learner navigation, and add focused verifiers with negative tests. The exercise uses a deterministic fictional review packet and completion scenarios so every learner can finish without a live repository, bot, or instructor.
narratives.Scope: In scope: the Module 11 story decomposed from training.modules9-11.review; the lesson, fixed review packet, explained solution, learner navigation, glossary and quick-reference material, source validation records, focused verifier and tests, and the related project and parent lifecycle records. Out of scope: the capstone, live GitHub or review-bot activity, Greptile, learner or business repositories, real CI, merge, deployment, UAT execution, a Directive release-pin change, publishing, push, pull-request creation, branch deletion, and worktree removal.
narratives.Impact: Completes the eleven-module core path with a 55-minute host-neutral exercise that teaches the pre-PR Read-Write-Lint-Diff loop, read-all-first finding classification, one coherent P0/P1 fix batch, current-head re-review, and separate Git delivery, deployment, and UAT evidence axes.
narratives.Risks: The material could overstate a PR-open or integration-merged state as complete, infer deployment or UAT from Git evidence, hide an unclassified or unresolved blocking finding, teach one push per finding, expand scope for an out-of-acceptance finding, depend on Greptile, or confuse the live 0.116.0 authoring deposit with the pinned 0.112.0 learner contract.
narratives.Approach: Revalidate the immutable Directive 0.112.0 pre-PR, review, and lifecycle sources; write failing Module 11 verifier tests; author the smallest fixed packet, lesson, and solution that satisfy the five story criteria; update exact navigation and source records; then run the literal Module 11 checks, xBRIEF conformance, and aggregate local gate.
narratives.Alternatives: A live pull request or review-bot lab was rejected because it would be mutable, platform-dependent, and contrary to the project's simulated-review and Greptile-disabled contracts. A disposable code-mutation lab was rejected because Module 10 already proves implementation and gates; Module 11's independent learning boundary is review judgment and evidence classification. Bundling the capstone was rejected because it remains a separate proposed scope.
narratives.Dependencies: The completed Module 9 and Module 10 curriculum, the exact @deftai/directive 0.112.0 learner pin, the 0.116.0 deposited authoring framework used only for drift comparison, Node.js 20 or newer, Git, npm, and the repository's existing Markdown and verifier patterns.
narratives.Authorization: David requested Module 11 implementation and replied confirmed to the explicit /deft:change module-11-curriculum confirmation request. The recorded cost choice is Option 1, Build. This authorizes local Module 11 implementation and its related lifecycle artifacts only; it does not authorize remote delivery or destructive cleanup.
narratives.Stops: Success: all Module 11 literal acceptance commands, focused negative tests, xBRIEF conformance, and the aggregate local gate pass. Failure: stop after at most five implementation fix iterations or three identical failures without progress, and at most three pre-PR review passes. Stop before push, pull-request creation, merge, deployment, publication, branch deletion, or worktree removal pending separate authorization.
